text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 15.590551px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: test_coupon_R3 (R3 arc): painting map, both pictures, 1:1

text.style: font-size: 7.653543px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: The coupon is R3 from -20° to 30°. Paint picture A on the LEFT face of every tooth, then picture B on the RIGHT faces.

text.style: font-size: 7.653543px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: The fine raised lines on the print follow the motif edges (tape along them). The small ring on top centres the washer.

text.style: font-size: 7.653543px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: Check from 40° left (the Magen David) and 40° right (HANUKKAH) before painting the big ring.
